GlobalPolicy.LogFormat: Structured app log bodies use service, level, and message.
GlobalPolicy.TraceMarkerFormat: Trace-bearing messages use [service][function][BLOCK_NAME] message; informational and warning messages may be plain text.
GlobalPolicy.Redaction: Never log secrets, credentials, raw tokens, or high-risk payloads beyond bounded existing policies.
GlobalPolicy.FreshEvidence: Completion claims require fresh command output or documented blockers.

V-M-WORKFLOW-DELEGATED.Scenario: Delegated open validation with empty reviewers and declared write scopes, callID-bound attempt allocation and results, per-session callID uniqueness across attempts and items, confirmed host-terminal launch failures recorded as failed attempts with consumed budget and bounded evidence, terminal report-rejection settlement preserving observed hard stops without fabricating DONE, the two-attempt budget, accept/request_changes decisions with concerns disposition, wrong-attempt and duplicate rejections, guarded checkpoint-authorized rework preserving history, bounded recovery resuming stops without manufactured budget and granting one unit per autonomous or replay-protected root-user authorization, recovery target validation, recovery/rework interaction, legacy-mode isolation, and the pure item-level ordinary-implementer launch gate (delegatedOrdinaryLaunchGate) shared by the real mutation path and read-only inspection.

A failed attempt keeps the item awaiting_implementer and retryable until the budget is exhausted, is refused when the item has already advanced or the callID is reused/ambiguous, and can never be accepted as a completed result. A report_rejected attempt is a completed execution with bounded diagnostics that cannot be accepted; the autonomous grant is denied after first use regardless of recoveryId; invalid, stale, assistant-authored, foreign-session, and reused authorizations fail without changing counters or state; recovery never resets rework identity and rework never consumes recovery grants; progress summaries expose remaining budget and a supported next action, and a refusal reported by read-only inspection is produced by the same shared launch gate the mutation enforces.
